references_used.why: Structural source of truth per reference-libraries/roofing.json — read directly from the local template source (no Firecrawl needed for structure). Section order, component shapes, and native EstimateForm come from here unmodified. No Firecrawl MCP available in this sandbox session, so the secondary/inspiration URLs (agcconcrete.com) were not scraped this run — the template alone is sufficient since it is the canonical structural source per the library file's own guidance.

brand_source: Client's own live site (curl fallback, no Firecrawl — see intake-scraped.json._notes.method). Accent #F9AA4C read directly from button background-color / border-color / hover-color declarations in the site's compiled CSS (this is a real authored color, distinct from the surrounding WordPress/Gutenberg default palette that was also present and explicitly NOT used). Body font 'Work Sans' read from a direct font-family declaration; no display font was confidently traceable to a real source, so it falls back to the template default rather than being guessed. No bg/surface/text/primary colors were confidently traceable to client CSS (only unmodified Gutenberg preset defaults were present at that layer), so this palette builds a supporting neutral/dark set around the one confirmed brand color, per design-reference's synthesis role.

contrast_audit.black_on_accent: 9.02:1 — AAA pass. Raw white-on-accent measures only 1.93:1 and fails, so on_accent is dark text (#1a1a1a), not white.
contrast_audit.accent_ink_on_bg: 6.55:1 — AA pass. accent_ink is a darkened derivative of the brand accent (#8a4f0c, not the raw #F9AA4C) specifically so the brand color can be used as body/link text — the raw accent only measures 3.78:1 on white and fails AA for normal text.
contrast_audit.accent_on_dark_over_primary: 7.91:1 — AAA pass. Unlike the template default (where raw accent fails on the dark band and needs a lighter tint), this primary (#2b2420) is dark/warm enough that the raw brand accent #F9AA4C already clears AA/AAA as text on it directly — no separate tint needed, accent_on_dark equals accent.

typography.source: Body font traced directly to the client's own CSS (font-family: "Work Sans"). Display font not traceable to a real source on the client's site — falls back to the template default (Fraunces) per intake-from-web's own documented fallback rule rather than being invented.

radius.source: No radius signal traceable to real client CSS — template defaults used unchanged.

avoid: generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats, generic hard-hat closeup)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template

unmodified WordPress/Gutenberg default color palette (vivid-purple, luminous-vivid-orange, etc.) — this is what the client's CURRENT site leans on and is exactly what this rebuild should replace with the real accent color

'storm damage on your roof' door-knocking sales framing anywhere in copy — flagged in local_research.json as a documented red-flag pattern for pushy/scam roofers; this business's own tone never uses it
